text: This parser keeps ordered interval comparisons for header phases and documents the one transition from Sig continuation back to accepting another Sig header. The reviewer offered explicit equality comparisons as a nonblocking alternative; the source retains the ordered model and its exception comment. Preserve this exact state contract when reading the comparisons. It is a local accepted choice, not a general rule for all state machines.
title: The mixed MIME parser documents its one backward state transition
